mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_report_file (id, title, template, is_deleted, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{template}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, template, is_deleted, created_time, updated_time FROM luck_report_file WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, title, template, is_deleted, created_time, updated_time FROM luck_report_file WHERE title = #{title} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
